summary.headline: Conservation Commission approves footbridge replacement and septic repairs, and advances Breakneck Hill restoration plans.
summary.summary: The Southborough Conservation Commission approved Orders of Conditions for an Eagle Scout footbridge project in the Town Forest and a septic replacement at Stonebrook Village. The commission also awarded a design and bid preparation contract to BSC Group for restoration work at Breakneck Hill Farm. Substantive discussions continued regarding proposed deed restriction modifications for the Fay School/New England Football Club athletic fields and liability terms for accepting a 6.2-acre open space donation off Turnpike Road.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The commission approved meeting minutes from October 8, 2026, and approved amended meeting minutes from October 29, 2026.
key_details: Approved minutes of October 8, 2026 (3-0 with 1 abstention)
Approved amended minutes of October 29, 2026 (3-0 with 1 abstention)

topics.title: Town Forest Eagle Scout footbridge replacement
topics.summary: The commission reviewed a Notice of Intent submitted by an Eagle Scout candidate to replace a deteriorated plywood crossing over a drainage ditch in the Town Forest with a sturdy wooden footbridge. The project received support from the Southborough Stewardship Committee and the conservation agent. The commission approved the project with standard conditions.
key_details: Location: Town Forest, Map 22, Lots 3A and 8
Replaces an unsafe, warped piece of plywood with a formal timber footbridge
Materials: pressure-treated lumber
Hearing closed and Order of Conditions issued

topics.title: Stonebrook Village septic absorption system replacement
topics.summary: Salisbury Management LLC sought approval for replacing a failed soil absorption system at Stonebrook Village. The commission discussed safeguards to ensure construction traffic crossing existing drainage features does not compromise stormwater facilities. The commission approved the application with conditions requiring engineering oversight during construction crossing and a professional engineer's certification prior to a Certificate of Compliance.
key_details: Location: Stonebrook Village, Map 15, Lot 16
Work involves replacing a failed Title 5 soil absorption system
Requires construction monitoring to protect existing stormwater retention volume and pipes
Condition added requiring PE certification that drainage infrastructure remains undamaged

topics.title: Costco Wholesale Notice of Intent continuance
topics.summary: The applicant for the proposed 167,000-square-foot Costco wholesale club and fuel facility at 21 Computer Drive (Coslin Drive) requested a continuance. The commission voted to continue the public hearing to its next meeting.
key_details: Location: 21 Coslin Drive, Map 25, Lot 4A
Project: 167,000-square-foot wholesale retail warehouse, fuel station, and site work
Applicant requested a continuance

topics.title: Fay School athletic fields and deed restriction adjustment
topics.summary: Field Engineering presented updated plans for the New England Football Club and Fay School athletic facility project at 0 Marlboro Junction. The revisions address peer review comments regarding riverfront mitigation planting and stormwater design adjustments to pocket wetlands. The applicant proposed adjusting existing conservation deed restriction boundaries to accommodate the relocated baseball field, swapping out roughly 13,600 square feet while adding approximately 17,000 square feet elsewhere.
key_details: Location: 0 Marlboro Junction, Map 91, Lot 6
Project includes turf field installation, baseball field relocation, and riverfront restoration
Proposed deed restriction swap increases restricted land slightly from 13.6 to 13.7 acres
Mitigation includes 30 trees and 100 shrubs across 25,000 square feet of restored riverfront
The commission will wait for its environmental consultant to evaluate the deed restriction swap

topics.title: Continuances for 250 Turnpike Road and 0 Southville Road
topics.summary: The commission considered procedural continuance requests for two pending hearings.
key_details: 250 Turnpike Road public hearing continued to December 10, 2026
0 Southville Road public hearing continued to December 10, 2026

topics.title: Breakneck Hill Farm restoration bid package contract award
topics.summary: The conservation agent reported on procurement for engineering services to draft a bid-ready restoration plan for Breakneck Hill Farm, covering trails, parking, the meadow, and dump area remediation. BSC Group submitted the sole responsive bid and was recommended for approval by the Southborough Stewardship Committee.
key_details: Project: design and bid specifications for comprehensive Breakneck Hill Farm restoration
Three vendors solicited; BSC Group was the only respondent
The Stewardship Committee reviewed and endorsed the proposal

topics.title: 120 Turnpike Road 6.2-acre open space conveyance
topics.summary: The commission reviewed the proposed deed transferring 6.2 acres of land adjacent to Breakneck Hill Farm to the town, a condition of the 120 Turnpike Road residential development. Commissioners raised concerns about town liability regarding an on-site drainage swale and easement maintained by the private development. The commission decided to consult Town Counsel about indemnification language and allow the Stewardship Committee time to review before taking a formal vote.
key_details: Donation involves 6.2 acres connecting to Breakneck Hill Farm open space
The property includes a stormwater swale subject to an easement for the adjacent development
The applicant seeks conveyance approval prior to the end of 2026
Commission indicated informal support but deferred formal acceptance pending Town Counsel review of liability protections
topics.outcome: Discussion continued to December 10, 2026 without formal vote.
topics.why_it_matters: Accepting open space parcels expands public conservation land but can create ongoing maintenance burdens or municipal liability if easements and drainage features are not properly structured.

topics.title: Administrative updates and continued hearing policy
topics.summary: The chair and agent discussed drafting a policy regarding prolonged continued hearings and consulting legal counsel. After losing a quorum when a member departed, the agent shared brief informational updates on site stabilization plantings at the Valvoline property, 2027 meeting dates, and research into Article 97 legal protections for town-owned open space parcels.
key_details: Discussion of potential limits or rules for repeatedly continued hearings
Quorum lost at 1:01:31; remaining items were informational only
Valvoline site has been seeded and planted with substitute native species for winter stabilization
Ongoing legal research into Article 97 status of town conservation parcels
topics.outcome: No action taken; meeting declared adjourned by the chair at 1:04:40.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing for the Town Forest Eagle Scout footbridge project.
Issue an Order of Conditions with standard conditions for the Town Forest Eagle Scout footbridge project.
Close the public hearing for the septic system replacement at Stonebrook Village.
Issue an Order of Conditions with special conditions for the septic system replacement at Stonebrook Village.
Continue the public hearing for 21 Coslin Drive (Costco) to December 10, 2026.
Continue the public hearing for 0 Marlboro Junction (Fay School/NEFC) to December 10, 2026.
Continue the public hearing for 250 Turnpike Road to December 10, 2026.
Continue the public hearing for 0 Southville Road to December 10, 2026.
Approve the contract award to BSC Group to prepare the Breakneck Hill Farm restoration bid package.

public_comment.summary: A member of the Southborough Stewardship Committee spoke in favor of the Eagle Scout footbridge replacement project in the Town Forest, noting stewards had visited the site with the applicant and look forward to collaborating.
A member of the Stewardship Committee confirmed that the committee reviewed BSC Group's proposal for the Breakneck Hill restoration plan and supported moving forward.

A member of the Stewardship Committee noted that while the committee had not yet formally reviewed the final deed for 120 Turnpike Road, members previously held concerns about taking on land with drainage swales and potential safety hazards.

upcoming.what: Continued hearings for Costco (21 Coslin Dr), Fay School (0 Marlboro Junction), 250 Turnpike Rd, 0 Southville Rd, and vote on 120 Turnpike Rd land donation
